title: Physician- and Patient-based Barriers to NGS Testing
official: A Clinical Trial to Address Physician- and Patient-based Barriers to NGS Testing
summary: The goal of this study is to improve next-generation sequencing (NGS) testing rates at Johns Hopkins in patients with metastatic prostate cancer. Investigators believe by targeting two barriers, provider-level and patient-level, will improve the testing rate of NGS at Johns Hopkins.

interventions.name: Provider-level and patient education at end of study

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* men diagnosed with metastatic prostate cancer
* seen by Johns Hopkins Medical Oncology as a new patient visit between January 1, 2025 and December 31, 2026

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Patients who have already had NGS testing performed.
sponsor: Sidney Kimmel Comprehensive Cancer Center at Johns Hopkins

sites.f: Johns Hopkins Sidney Kimmel Comprehensive Cancer Center
